BNY Mellon described strong, above-market growth in its ETF servicing business throughout 2023 and 2024. In Q4 2023, the company noted "continued strength" with another quarter of strong net inflows that capped a year of above-market growth. During 2024, this momentum continued with significant increases in Assets Under Custody/Assets (AUC/A):

*   **Q2 2024:** ETF AUC/A was over $2 trillion, up more than 50% year-over-year.
*   **Q3 2024:** ETF AUC/A reached $2.7 trillion, up more than 70% year-over-year, with inflows outpacing the market across all asset classes.
*   **Q4 2024:** ETF AUC/A grew to $2.8 trillion, up over 60% year-over-year, again outpacing market inflows.

The company attributed this growth to higher market values and client inflows, including a large mandate in Ireland from a leading global asset manager, while also highlighting the successful onboarding of new liquidity providers to its electronic order execution platform.
